data.name: Kenika
data.gender_notes: Kenika is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Kenika is derived from the Sanskrit name 'Kali', which represents the divine mother and the goddess of time, change, and destruction. The prefix 'Keni' denotes grace, kindness, and compassion, making Kenika a powerful name that embodies the blessings of the goddess Kali. The name Kenika carries the meaning “Goddess Kali's Grace” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Kenika usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess kali's grace and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that carries the divine blessings of the goddess Kali, symbolizing grace, compassion, and strength.
data.etymology: Kenika belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Goddess Kali's Grace.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kenika total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
